description: This file contains helper functions for configuring and managing PUCCH, PRACH, SR, CSI, and PUSCH resources in a 3GPP-compliant radio system, including resource interval calculations, resource list building, and time domain resource recomputation.

methods.name: find_pucch_inner_prbs
methods.description: Calculates the inner PRB interval of a given PUCCH resource, assuming resources are on opposite sides of the BWP.

methods.name: find_largest_prb_interval_without_pucch
methods.description: Determines the largest PRB interval within a BWP that is free of PUCCH resources.

methods.name: compute_prach_frequency_start
methods.description: Calculates the starting PRB index for PRACH, maintaining a guardband from PUCCH.

methods.name: compute_nof_sr_csi_pucch_res
methods.description: Estimates the number of PUCCH resources needed for SR and CSI based on their periods and maximum grants.

methods.name: compute_max_nof_pucch_symbols
methods.description: Computes the maximum number of PUCCH symbols per slot based on SRS and PUCCH configurations.

methods.name: recompute_pusch_time_domain_resources
methods.description: Recomputes PUSCH time domain resource allocations considering TDD configurations and resource sharing constraints.
